description: This file defines a Flutter widget called FavoritesTab, which displays a grid of favorite recipes using data provided by RecipeProvider and FavoritesProvider. It uses provider package for state management and includes UI components like GridView and RecipeCard.

classes.name: FavoritesTab
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a grid of favorite recipes, allowing users to view recipe details and toggle favorite status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the FavoritesTab, displaying recipes marked as favorites or a message if none are found.
